C and D remain outside on fixture:origin and cannot Counterspell across planes. A is Dead at the 127.2/133.2 windows. No responder is eligible for B’s interior Arcane Sight or Arch Dispel; no response is spent.
adoptedScenario.persistence: Apply Core zero-HP callbacks. A's same body, HP, Wounds, death counters and item identities persist. Fortress remains the same active nonconcentrating root after A's death; its space and entrance persist. Clay tile retains ID and expiry 3606.13.

focusSetDown.interaction: A uses one ordinary free object interaction to set down focus-A.
focusSetDown.controlledPath: A moves focus-A by hand from the exact S030 occupied bounds to the supported floor pose; no teleport or extra action.

bodyPoseAtZero.posture: Prone and Unconscious at 109.3; same body remains until Dead at 126.
bodyPoseAtZero.postureHeightBasis: Exact 4 ft branch-only prone/posture envelope; not a general Medium creature or corpse dimension.
bodyPoseAtZero.classification: narrow TEST_ONLY pose; preserves the living Medium 5×5 occupied footprint

tileDrop.release: After damage and Wound-save resolution, the zero-HP callback releases the tile at its existing z0-supported position [25,5,0], with zero displacement/impact.

carriedOnCorpse.attachment: Preserve the same existing pack-A and cargo-A identities, owners and custodians at their exact S030 body-relative positions; no generic equipment-support rule.
carriedOnCorpse.support: A’s 150 lb body is supported by the existing Fortress z0 floor patch; the exact strapped item bounds remain within its 5×5×4 local posture envelope.

bExit.at115: B uses the Grounding Action only; spends no movement and remains at [15,10,0].
bExit.stairRouteAvoidance: No interior movement or exit approach is made; the previously proposed sweep through the southwest tower stairs is removed.
bExit.closurePositionConvention: position is minimum x/y and feet z; not an XY center
